downloads.name: Any device
downloads.sub: Runs in your browser — phone, tablet, Chromebook or computer.
downloads.note: On a phone: open it, then Share → Add to Home Screen (iPhone) or ⋮ → Install app (Android).

downloads.name: Windows
downloads.note: If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info → Run anyway.

downloads.name: Mac
downloads.note: Unzip, drag ChemFlip to Applications. The first time, right-click it → Open.

downloads.name: Linux
downloads.note: AppImage: make it executable (chmod +x) and double-click.

downloads.name: Android
downloads.note: Coming soon to Google Play. Until then, open the web app and tap ⋮ → Install app.

downloads.name: iPhone & iPad
downloads.note: Coming soon to the App Store. Until then, open the web app in Safari and tap Share → Add to Home Screen.
